[LFAC.1.7.5] The identity key is the single answer every
identity consumer reads: retract-and-replace dedup
([LFAC.1.2.2]), cooldown keying ([LCDB.3.3.1]),
no-linear-scan join anchors ([LNLS.3.3]), series grouping
([LSER.7.6.1]), and debug display names ([RDSC.6.8.4]). No
consumer resolves identity independently.
